A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Several members of this species served as security guards on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Bazarre]].<ref name="Marvel59" /> A representative of this species was also present at the [[First Conference of Free Peoples]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Marvel90" />
